# AIInfraWatch — AI Infrastructure Market Intelligence

> An independent index of public GPU pricing across major cloud providers.

## What this site provides

AIInfraWatch tracks GPU instance pricing across 16 tracked cloud providers (15 active, 1 partial),
updated daily. Data includes spot prices, on-demand rates, and availability signals.

## Public APIs (no authentication required)

### GPU Prices
GET /api/gpu-prices
Returns current GPU listings across all providers.
Query params: gpu (H100|A100|L40S|A10G), provider, type (spot|on-demand), limit, format (json|csv)
Example: /api/gpu-prices?gpu=H100&type=spot

### Energy & Grid Data
GET /api/energy
Experimental. Energy data is seed/indicative and not refreshed on a fixed schedule.

### Market Summary
GET /api/providers
Returns market-wide averages, cheapest options, and provider count.

## Data coverage

Providers tracked (15 active, 1 partial):
RunPod, AWS, Azure, GCP, CoreWeave, Lambda Labs, Nebius, TensorDock, OCI, Paperspace, Crusoe, FluidStack, IBM Cloud, GMI Cloud, VoltagePark (active); Vast.ai (partial)

GPU models indexed (DC families only):
H100 SXM5 80GB, H100 SXM 80GB, H100 NVL 80GB, A100 SXM 80GB, A100 PCIe 80GB, L40S 48GB, A10G 24GB, L40 48GB, A10 24GB, A30 24GB, A40 48GB, B200

## Data freshness
- GPU prices: updated daily (cron runs once daily at 00:00 UTC)
- Energy prices: experimental, not on a fixed schedule
- Latency benchmarks: experimental, not on a fixed schedule

## Response format
All APIs return JSON with this structure:
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": {
    "fetched_at": "ISO timestamp",
    "count": number,
    "cache_ttl_seconds": number,
    "source": "live|cached|seed"
  }
}

## Use cases for AI agents
- Find cheapest reliable GPU instance for a DC workload (H100, A100, L40S)
- Compare spot vs on-demand pricing across providers
- Identify provider concentration risk in a given GPU family
- Evaluate production-safe vs observed-only availability signals
